[EN] The good news is the riots have calmed down. The bad news is now we've got warthog problems.

They're all over Digory's Farmstead, and those crops make up at least half of our supplies for Velika.

If you could get over there and help us out, everyone would appreciate it.
[ES] La buena noticia es que los disturbios se han calmado. La mala noticia es que ahora tenemos problemas con jabalíes.

Están por todo Digory's Farmstead, y esos cultivos componen al menos la mitad de nuestros suministros para Velika.

Si pudieras ir allá y ayudarnos, todos te lo agradecerían.

[EN] Oh, that's a relief. Thanks for clearing that up.
[ES] Oh, qué alivio. Gracias por aclararlo.
